Name: Shared Fridge With Spouse
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages:[/b] English（English descriptions are below）, 简体中文

[b][size=5]Shared Fridge With Spouse 和伴侣共享冰箱[/size][/b]

Shared Fridge With Spouse 是一个适用于《星露谷物语》1.6 的轻量级 SMAPI 模组。
你的伴侣（配偶或是室友）会偶尔从厨房冰箱里拿走他们喜欢的可食用物品。食物被拿走后，打开冰箱时会显示当天提示，也可以通过冰箱上方的历史记录按钮（或打开冰箱后按快捷键H）查看最近的消耗记录。（历史记录最多保留50条）
消耗食物会增加好感，相当于一次正常送礼，但不占用送礼次数。
消耗食物当天会有相关对话。原版可结婚对象和科罗布斯拥有符合各自性格的专属台词。

[b]冰箱便签[/b]
伴侣偶尔会在冰箱上留下便签，可打开冰箱点击便签按钮查看。
有些便签只是日常留言；有些会请求一种食物或者料理食材。如果你选择答应请求，并且冰箱里有放入对应物品，第二天伴侣会使用它，并留下一张感谢便签。
忽略便签不会扣好感或产生惩罚。

[b]伴侣做菜（1.4.0新增）[/b]
按下 [b]F10[/b] 可以选择你爱吃的菜肴。之后，每位伴侣或室友每天都有概率制作其中一道，并放入冰箱。
默认概率为 [b]20%[/b]，不会消耗原料。成功后会写入历史记录，并在交谈时出现相关对话。

[b]主要配置[/b]
[list]
[*]每日取用食物概率：默认 50%。[/*]
[*]冰箱搜索范围：主厨房冰箱或屋内所有冰箱（包括地窖）。[/*]
[*]每种物品保留数量：默认保留 1 份。[/*]
[*]允许取用喜欢的食物：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]允许负能量食物：默认关闭；开启后可支持科罗布斯等 NPC 的特殊喜好。[/*]
[*]请求菜肴只使用已学会菜谱：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]保护高价食物：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]高价食物最低金额：默认 1000g。[/*]
[*]打开冰箱时显示取用提示：默认开启。[/*]
[*]伴侣每日做饭概率：默认 20%。[/*]
[*]便签、历史记录和菜肴选择快捷键。[/*]
[*]冰箱按钮组的水平与垂直位置。[/*]
[/list]配置可通过 config.json 修改，也支持 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]。

[b]兼容性[/b]
[list]
[*]支持多婚/多伴侣，会识别所有已婚或室友 NPC （已测试 PolyamorySweet）。[/*]
[*]支持自定义 NPC，只要该 NPC  能像其他村民一样结婚或成为室友，并且有自己的礼物喜好数据。[/*]
[*]1.3.2版本以后兼容安卓版（部分功能需要使用虚拟键盘）[/*]
[/list]
mod将持续免费更新。如果它对你有帮助，也欢迎[url=https://lognest111.github.io/wechat.png]赞赏作者[/url]。
 
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Shared Fridge With Spouse is a lightweight SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Your spouse or roommate will occasionally take edible items they like from the kitchen fridge. After food is taken, a notification will appear the next time you open the fridge. You can also check recent consumption records using the history button above the fridge, or by pressing the H key while the fridge is open. (The history keeps a maximum of 50 entries)
Eating food increases friendship, just like a normal gift, but does not count toward the daily or weekly gift limit.
On the day food is taken, there will also be related dialogue.Vanilla marriage candidates and Krobus have dialogue written to match their personalities.

[b]Fridge Notes[/b]
Your spouse may occasionally leave a note on the fridge. Open the fridge and click the note button to read it.
Some notes are simple daily messages, while others may request a food item or an ingredient for tomorrow’s cooking. If you choose to accept the request and the matching item is in the fridge, your spouse will use it the next day and leave a thank-you note.
Ignoring a note will not reduce friendship or cause any penalty.

[b]Partner Cooking (New in 1.4.0)[/b]
Press [b]F10[/b] to select dishes you enjoy. Each spouse or roommate then has an independent daily chance to cook one of them and place it in the fridge.
The default chance is [b]20%[/b]. Cooking uses no ingredients. Successful dishes are added to the fridge history and can trigger dialogue.

[b]Config Options[/b]
[list]
[*]Daily food consumption chance: 50% by default.[/*]
[*]Fridge search scope: main kitchen or all fridge chests inside your farmhouse and its cellar.[/*]
[*]Reserved stock per item: keeps 1 by default.[/*]
[*]Allow liked foods: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Allow negative-energy foods: disabled by default; useful for unusual tastes such as Krobus's.[/*]
[*]Filter direct dish requests by learned recipes: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Protect valuable foods: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Valuable food threshold: 1000g by default.[/*]
[*]Show fridge notifications: enabled by default.[/*]
[*]Daily partner cooking chance: 20% by default.[/*]
[*]Custom keybinds for notes, history, and dish selection.[/*]
[*]Horizontal and vertical offsets for the fridge buttons.[/*]
[/list]Config can be edited through config.json, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is also supported.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Supports multi-spouse / multi-partner setups by detecting all married or roommate NPCs. Tested with PolyamorySweet.[/*]
[*]Supports custom NPCs, as long as the NPC can marry or become a roommate like other villagers and has their own gift taste data.[/*]
[*]Android compatibility is supported in version 1.3.2 and later.  [/*]
[/list]
